# The night sky fixes of fix/sky98, each caught in a burst of frames (1280x720, GUI scale 2 as the test world starts):
# 1. Pulse with the lyrics on: when the lyrics go (here the open chat hides them, with Hide in menus on) the aurora
#    eases up to full brightness over about a second, and back down when they return. With the old code it is a third
#    brighter from one frame to the next, about a third of a second into the burst. Switching the pulse off eases the
#    same way. (A new lyric line can still lift the sky for a moment in the frames before the lyrics are gone.)
# 2. Constellations off (with the aurora on) fade out over 1.5 s; with the old code they are gone in the first frame.
#    Then Night sky Off with every other sky effect off fades the aurora out instead of cutting it in one frame, and
#    Constellations on fades them in. Compare the frames of each burst, first to last.
# Run it, and with -f mod_ref=main to compare with the old code:
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/sky98 -f version=1.21.11 -f script=.github/checks/sky-fixes.txt
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/sky98 -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=main -f script=.github/checks/sky-fixes.txt

# A clear night that stays night; the lyrics pinned to the north, looking west of them where the aurora and the six-star
# constellation show (as in pictures.txt's sky-aurora-constellations)
cmd weather clear
cmd time set midnight
cmd gamerule doDaylightCycle false
cmd gamerule advance_time false
set direction NORTH
set sky AURORA
set skyStrength 0.7
set constellations true
set shootingStars false
set twinkle false
set skyPulse true
set hideInMenus true
look 258 -34
sleep 12
shot sky98-pulse-resting

# 1. The lyrics hide under the open chat: the sky eases up instead of jumping
chat
burst sky98-pulse-chat-open 16 100
wait burst sky98-pulse-chat-open wrote
sleep 2
shot sky98-pulse-chat-settled
close
burst sky98-pulse-chat-closed 16 100
wait burst sky98-pulse-chat-closed wrote
sleep 3
# The pulse switched off while the sky rests between lines
set skyPulse false
burst sky98-pulse-off 16 100
wait burst sky98-pulse-off wrote
set hideInMenus false
sleep 3

# 2. Constellations off with the aurora on: they fade out
shot sky98-constellations-on
set constellations false
burst sky98-constellations-off 12 150
wait burst sky98-constellations-off wrote
# Night sky Off, nothing else on: the aurora fades out
sleep 3
shot sky98-aurora-before-off
set sky OFF
burst sky98-sky-off 12 150
wait burst sky98-sky-off wrote
sleep 2
shot sky98-sky-off-settled
# Aurora back, then Constellations on: they fade in
set sky AURORA
sleep 6
set constellations true
burst sky98-constellations-on 12 150
wait burst sky98-constellations-on wrote

# Back as the test world starts
set direction FOLLOW
look 0 -28
sleep 2
